description: This file contains a custom Jackson serializer for Java's LocalDate class, converting LocalDate objects into ISO 8601 formatted date strings for JSON serialization.

classes.name: LocalDateSerializer
classes.description: A custom serializer extending Jackson's StdSerializer to convert LocalDate objects into ISO date strings in JSON.

methods.name: LocalDateSerializer()
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the serializer for LocalDate class.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Converts a LocalDate object into a string formatted as 'yyyy-MM-dd' and writes it to the JSON output.
